caption: The drawing depicts a circular, reddish-brown ceramic plate with a segment missing from its upper right edge. The plate features a wide rim decorated with a repeating yellow wavy line pattern. The central area of the plate contains an illustration of a yellow bird with a dark neck, beak, and legs standing on a dark-colored patch that represents the ground. To the left of the bird, there is a green leafy plant with curved stems and leaves. The composition is centered on the plate, with additional concentric yellow lines encircling the central illustration, separating it from the rim’s wavy pattern. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Economy Pie Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
